title: Bounds on the Mordell-Weil rank of elliptic fibrations
summary: We prove that the Mordell-Weil group of a higher dimensional elliptic fibration naturally embeds into that of a suitable elliptic surface. We give sufficient conditions for the existence of such surfaces. We apply our result to obtain explicit and uniform bounds for the Mordell-Weil rank of elliptic threefolds of Kodaira dimension zero, including Calabi-Yau threefolds, confirming predictions from physics.
